cases.title: Complete entry accounting
cases.action: Project a real COMPLETE snapshot with INDEXED/EXCLUDED/ERROR entries.
cases.expected: REPO_MANIFEST count and exact ordinal/path/OID/mode set match all repo_entries; no PENDING and no skipped tail.

cases.title: Exact source-to-part ranges
cases.action: Multi-part INDEXED source, empty and nonempty files.
cases.expected: Every indexed chunk maps once; half-open byte intervals tile source, empty chunk valid, assembled SHA/size correct.

cases.title: Binary/UTF8/long-line handling
cases.action: Use >20 parts in one UTF8 source, CRLF/BOM and non-UTF8 captured blob.
cases.expected: Bytes preserved; raw-only versus text eligibility explicit; no character-based offsets or fake AI-read claim.
cases.evidence_required: Source byte hashes and legacy text-item integrity checks where applicable

cases.title: Gap metadata and protected exclusions
cases.action: Excluded name, unsupported encoded path, submodule metadata, oversized ERROR.
cases.expected: Original states/reasons/OID/size retained, missing hashes null; no protected raw bytes in metadata; all_tracked_bytes_exportable=false.

cases.title: Entries/parts pagination and byte budget
cases.action: Read all ENTRIES/PARTS pages, including >20 chunks for one file and row-budget cut.
cases.expected: Exact full result set once; nextOffset advances only by emitted rows; actual serialized frame<=32768 and native limits unchanged.
cases.evidence_required: Native serialized-size and whole-tail equality receipt

cases.title: Bidirectional lookup
cases.action: Navigate fileOrdinal→parts and returned part→source, then change file filter.
cases.expected: Exact snapshot/file ordinal/path; same chunk IDs/ranges; query-relative offset cannot silently continue old filter.
cases.evidence_required: Real UI/native lookup plus stale-query test

cases.title: Deterministic binding and files
cases.action: Project same snapshot twice; separately vary export policy/goal or grouping policy version in authorized future contract fixture.
cases.expected: Same binding produces byte-identical JSONL and hashes; changed binding changes batch ID; no timestamps/absolute paths in canonical files.
cases.evidence_required: Two writer outputs comparison and digest oracle

cases.title: Pending/corrupt snapshot refusal
cases.action: Try incomplete snapshot; delete entry, duplicate/missing/orphan chunk, overlap/gap ranges and mismatched revision.
cases.expected: No verified BATCH or published metadata directory; explicit CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE/CONTEXT_CORRUPT; valid original data preserved.

cases.title: Raw/hash/revision tamper
cases.action: Alter chunk raw bytes/hash or stored file hash without consistent original source binding.
cases.expected: Full proof fails; per-page checks do not claim whole-corpus verification; no forged PASS.

cases.title: Consistent read view and historical snapshot
cases.action: Write unrelated snapshot data during export; move HEAD after complete capture.
cases.expected: One SQLite read view yields original pinned binding; no working-tree read/fetch, no mixed snapshots; old captured scope remains inspectable under active profile.
cases.evidence_required: Concurrent read fixture + instrumentation proving no Git/source-code calls

cases.title: Strict native scope and compatibility
cases.action: Wrong alias/namespace/profile, caller-supplied output/root, unknown fields; old bridge/DB endpoints.
cases.expected: Typed rejection outside scope; new command only if advertised; legacy scan/get/export/task/review data unchanged; no second DB.
cases.evidence_required: Actual NativeClient→JobHost→Python subprocess roundtrip and old-schema comparison

cases.title: Atomic output and interruption
cases.action: Interrupt before BATCH publication; inject disk-full; repeat on valid or corrupted existing target.
cases.expected: Unverified staging is never advertised READY/PASS; originals/valid output preserved; duplicate verified projection compares hashes; corruption explicit.
cases.evidence_required: Writer filesystem fault tests; full resume deferred to PR003

cases.title: Coverage semantics and UI late replies
cases.action: INFO before global validation; read one part page; switch repo/query with delayed reply.
cases.expected: Metadata completeness, returned-page proof and full raw proof distinct; AI packet/graph claims absent; stale page cannot overwrite current selection.
cases.evidence_required: UI/DTO integration with actual proof scope

cases.title: Empty snapshot and file-name encoding
cases.action: Empty Git tree; source paths containing newline/tab/quote/RU characters in metadata.
cases.expected: Zero-count manifest valid, empty-file case distinct; one JSONL record per entry despite path escapes; textContent rendering and portable index refs.
cases.evidence_required: JSONL line-count/parser roundtrip and empty real snapshot
